新世界第五年秋，秦川在青山村木屋里写完了凡人医药手册第四版的最后一页。他将笔搁在笔山上，站起来推开木窗。窗外老槐树的叶子已经开始变黄，但枝头还挂着几簇新发的嫩芽——今年已是第三次抽芽。
苏木槿从医馆回来，手里提着一盏新换的防风灯。她进门时看到他站在窗前，将灯放在桌上，走到他旁边。两人并肩看着窗外老槐树在晚风中沙沙作响，远处后山方向，轮回剑仍然斜倚在石碑旁，剑身上的银灰色光泽在月光下安静地亮着。村口劈柴声已经歇了，但柴棚里新劈的木柴正散发着松脂的清香。
她忽然开口：“你说，下一个穿越过来的倒霉蛋，会不会也掉在青山村？”
“不一定。说不定掉在恐惧峡谷，直接落在阿兹克尔的沙棘地里。那就惨了——那片地要浇水的。浇水要打水，打水要从温泉那边走很远。”他停了一下，“不过有苏木槿的医馆。只要她能走到村口老槐树下，就能看见你的医馆牌子——不收费，不登记。只收故事。”
她笑了，将他的手拉过来轻轻握住。
“如果真有那一天，我希望他能遇到一个像你一样的人。”苏木槿说。
秦川没有说话。窗外的月光将两人的影子投在墙上，和这些年来无数个深夜一样。防风灯在桌上安静地亮着，灯焰外围那一圈极淡的蓝色在夜风中微微晃动。
远处，观澜殿档案室里，目盲女孩正在灯焰中用指尖读取今天的日志。蛛网各地节点的简报仍在不断传入。那枚茧在赵伯的铜灯旁边微微发光。里面所有的声音都在——王屠户的大笑、李神医的叮嘱、欧阳矩的沉实、老陆劈柴的笃笃声。他们从未离开。他们只是换了一种方式，继续守护着这个不再需要至尊的世界。
青山村的老槐树在夜风中沙沙作响，又一片淡白色的花瓣落在石棋盘上。赵伯的棋盘上，黑白棋子还在棋篓里，叠得整整齐齐。

> Chapter 300 Finale (Page 1)
In the autumn of the fifth year of the new world, Qin Chuan finished writing the last page of the fourth edition of the Mortal Medicine Manual in the wooden house in Qingshan Village. He placed the pen on the pen mountain, stood up and pushed open the wooden window. The leaves of the old locust tree outside the window have begun to turn yellow, but there are still a few clusters of new buds hanging on the branches - this is the third time this year.
Su Muxin came back from the hospital with a new windproof lamp in her hand. When she came in, she saw him standing in front of the window, put the lamp on the table, and walked next to him. The two of them looked out the window side by side as the old locust tree rustled in the evening breeze. In the distance toward the back mountain, the Samsara Sword was still leaning against the stone monument, and the silver-gray luster on the sword shone quietly in the moonlight. The sound of chopping firewood at the entrance of the village has stopped, but the freshly chopped firewood in the woodshed is exuding the fragrance of rosin.
She suddenly said: "Tell me, will the next unlucky guy who comes through time also end up in Qingshan Village?"
"Not sure. Maybe it fell in the Fear Canyon, or directly in Azkel's sea buckthorn field. That would be tragic - that land needs to be watered. To water it, you need to fetch water, and to fetch water, you have to walk a long way from the hot spring." He paused, "But there is Su Mujin's medical clinic. As long as she can walk under the old locust tree at the entrance of the village, she can see your medical clinic sign - no fees, no registration. Only stories."
She smiled, took his hand and held it gently.
"If that day comes, I hope he can meet someone like you." Su Mujin said.
Qin Chuan said nothing. The moonlight outside the window casts the shadows of the two people on the wall, just like countless late nights over the years. The hurricane lamp lit quietly on the table, and the very light blue circle around the flame swayed slightly in the night wind.
In the distance, in the archives room of Guanlan Hall, a blind girl is reading today's diary with her fingertips in the light of the lamp. Briefings from various nodes in the spider web are still coming in. The cocoon glowed faintly next to Uncle Zhao's copper lamp. All the sounds inside were there - Butcher Wang's laughter, Doctor Li's instructions, Ouyang Ju's seriousness, and Lao Lu's clinking sound of chopping firewood. They never left. They just changed their ways and continued to protect this world that no longer needed the Supreme.
The old locust tree in Qingshan Village rustled in the night wind, and another pale white petal fell on the stone chessboard. On Uncle Zhao's chessboard, the black and white chess pieces were still in the chess baskets, neatly stacked.
